title: Kissed Peruvian Ground Pork Dumplings
description: Pillowy Peruvian dumplings filled with ground pork and a hint of sweetness, perfect for a post-workout meal or snack, and jain-friendly by using candy as a sweetener and avoiding any root vegetables or other non-jain ingredients.

ingredients.name: ground pork
ingredients.notes: use lean ground pork for a healthier option

ingredients.name: candy
ingredients.notes: use a jain-friendly candy like gummies or caramels

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.notes: use a small onion and finely chop it

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.notes: mince the garlic for the best flavor

ingredients.name: ginger
ingredients.notes: grate the ginger for the best flavor

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground pork, candy, onion, garlic, and ginger, and mix well until all the ingredients are fully incorporated.
Lay a dumpling wrapper on a flat surface and place a tablespoon of the pork mixture in the center of the wrapper.
Dip your finger in a small amount of water and run it along the edge of the wrapper.
Fold the wrapper into a triangle by bringing the two opposite corners together to form a point.
Press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
In a large pot of boiling water, cook the dumplings for 10-12 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Remove the dumplings from the water with a slotted spoon and serve hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
